news.title: New major risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$10m. Market cap: ₹906.8m (US$9.67m) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. news.body:
Maheshkumar Jatashankar Thanki,  Bhargav Girjashankar Thanki, Bhavin Harihar Thanki, Kalpana Ashwinkumar Thanki,Hema Bhargav Thanki,  Gautam Ashwinkumar Thank agreed to acquire 62.99% stake in Glittek Granites Limited (BSE:513528) from Manjula Agarwal, Tushar Agarwal,  Ashoke Agarwal, Ashoke Agarwal & Others HU and Kosen Ventures Private Limited on January 6, 2026.

The transaction is subject to approval by regulatory board / committee.
